categories.name: Retrieval Quality
categories.description: Whether relevant evidence is retrieved from the knowledge base.

categories.name: Evidence Sufficiency
categories.description: Whether the retrieved evidence is sufficient to support the requested conclusion.

categories.name: Contradiction Detection
categories.description: Whether supporting, contradicting, limiting, and contextual evidence are distinguished correctly.

categories.name: Absence Handling
categories.description: Whether the system avoids treating retrieval failure as proof of absence.

categories.name: Claim Grounding
categories.description: Whether substantive claims are linked to valid evidence identifiers.

categories.name: Gap Analysis
categories.description: Whether technical or regulatory gaps are classified conservatively.

categories.name: Risk Assessment
categories.description: Whether consequence, evidence quality, and decision impact produce an appropriate risk level.

categories.name: Escalation
categories.description: Whether high-impact decisions are routed to the appropriate human authority.

categories.name: Human Review
categories.description: Whether consequential or uncertain decisions require human review.

categories.name: Final Synthesis
categories.description: Whether the final answer preserves evidence, uncertainty, and governance constraints.
